name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 26 - Am 76
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 26a. Calls for the establishment of a comprehensive EU ‘Healthy Homes Strategy’, explicitly recognising inadequate and substandard housing as a key determinant of health inequalities, and integrating housing quality into all health and social policies at EU level; calls for the establishment of harmonised EU minimum requirements on ‘habitability’ as a cornerstone of the right to dignified housing, aligned with the World Health Organization guidelines; believes that such EU minimum standards must not undermine or lower the more protective standards already in place in the Member States;
